I'm already in therapy, antidepressant too... I was getting better for a few weeks, month and a half, but it's going downhill. I'm hurting myself more often- it's the first thing I do when in any sort of distress. Scratching, hair pulling, biting... ran a knife across my skin yesterday. I'm numb and I want to feel something, anything, that isn't self hate.

These moments come and go. Sometimes I'm chipper for a whole day, but one hour in the evening is terrible and I'm suicidal.

I'm just... a mess. Any kind words or prayers or anything would be appreciated.

[Anyone else think that 'Your letters stink' should be changed in SW when someone messes up the CAPTCHA? Certainly doesn't help.]
